en-US: Collapse the editor toolbar when more writing space is needed.
Companion discovery notifications and action cards are clearer, more concise, and easier to act on.
Desktop native menus now follow the Chinese interface language.
Windows Preview can now be installed to a custom location.
New notes keep editor focus while desktop sync updates arrive, preventing interrupted typing.
zh-CN: 编辑器工具栏现可折叠，按需腾出更多书写空间。
伴侣发现通知与操作卡片更加清晰简洁，也更便于直接处理。
桌面端原生菜单现可跟随中文界面显示。
Windows 预览版现支持选择自定义安装位置。
桌面端同步更新到达时，新建笔记仍会保持编辑焦点，避免打断输入。
